superseded_by.reason: This signal blamed an app-level blocked event loop in mcp-server. That root cause is WRONG. The real fault was the Docker VM fs event-injection layer (FATAL at 05:47:39.42Z); the count=107/visible_now=0 write-invisibility this signal reported is exactly what a failing fs-sharing layer produces, i.e. it was collateral, not the cause.
superseded_by.action_for_ops: Do NOT investigate mcp-server application code on the basis of this signal. Read the superseding signal instead. Retained rather than deleted so the corrected diagnosis has an audit trail.
